status: component hypothesis only; full candidate must first pass a validation gate
basis: The first completed candidate preserves all twelve cost values but ranks first on zero of six quality metrics. Preserving the current refit fixes the catastrophic study-outcome timeout fallback, but does not create new predictive information.
hypothesis: Task-local summaries of already observed historical training outcomes may complement relational features, especially where generic activity/static features miss the exact target.
allowed_input: Only the full task training split, already exposed with labels to every benchmark arm. The fixed final learner still trains on the same original 50,000-row sample. Full training-label summaries are an explicitly disclosed feature-engineering step, not a change to the learner sample.
information_time: A training target observed from seed_time over a horizon is usable only at seed_time + horizon or later. Every feature at a seed filters the outcome availability time to be <= that seed's time. Do not use the seed's own target, overlapping future target windows, validation labels or test labels.
forbidden: label-generation SQL as an optimizer input
test labels or scores as features or selectors
first_component: Generate generic own-entity and global historical count/mean/rate/recency statistics from training outcomes, with no task-specific feature recipes. Check exact temporal behavior and censor future training labels in an additional audit; never weaken the existing public-table audit.
component_evaluation: Use archived own v1 programs only in a separate implementation/validation diagnostic, never to initialize a new arm. Compare the unchanged fixed learner on original and augmented features using train and validation only. All input queries, fits, elapsed time and failures remain recorded.
decision: Only implement a from-empty candidate if the component shows useful validation gains within the available cost headroom. Keep the existing four frozen studies untouched. A component score is not benchmark test-quality evidence.
limits: Post-hoc development after the completed v1 results were inspected. The original test split is not a new independent holdout. Any later publication must disclose this timing and the additional historical-label preprocessing.
